sketchMechanisms: ARC zeroing weak references: a weak variable does not retain its object and is automatically set to nil when the last strong reference leaves scope.
The pin operator in a pattern match prevents rebinding and requires the new value to equal the old one, otherwise the match fails.
An interface value is nil only when both its dynamic type and dynamic value are nil; a nil pointer stored in an interface becomes non-nil because it carries a type.
